scenes.name: SAME POPULATIONS
lines: Imagine four energy levels, labeled zero, one, three, and seven. Each has probability one quarter, before and after a change.
设四个能级的能量为零、一、三、七，变化前后每个能级的概率都是四分之一。
The change is in coherence: how quantum amplitudes fit together. A probability table alone cannot describe it.
变化发生在相干性上，即量子振幅彼此的关系。只列概率还不够。

scenes.name: BUILD THE TARGET
lines: Start with equal amplitudes. Four unit rows define a Gram matrix, a table of pairwise inner products.
从相等振幅出发。四个单位行向量的两两内积构成 Gram 矩阵。
The last two rows use three fifths and four fifths, with one imaginary phase. Two diagonal Kraus operators produce this target while keeping every population fixed.
最后两行使用五分之三和五分之四，其中一项带虚相位。两个对角 Kraus 算子产生目标，且所有能级概率不变。

scenes.name: NO ENERGY LOSS
lines: Now demand a finite bath, uniform on its entire ground space, and a joint unitary that conserves total energy.
现在要求环境有限、初态在完整基态空间均匀混合，且联合酉演化守恒总能量。
The bath cannot supply energy. Every downward jump would lose energy. Unchanged populations force all those jumps to vanish, leaving four unitary bath blocks.
环境不能提供能量，每个向下跃迁都会损失能量。概率不变迫使这些跃迁全部消失，只留下四个酉的环境块。

scenes.name: TWO RELATIONS
lines: The unitary blocks must have the same Gram matrix as our four rows. Zero residual length transfers both row relations to the blocks.
四个酉块必须有相同的 Gram 矩阵。残差长度为零，将两条行关系传给这些块。
Call the product of the first block and the second adjoint X. The two relations force X to equal zero. But X is unitary: impossible on a nonzero space.
把第一个块与第二个块的共轭转置之积记作 X。两条关系迫使 X 为零，但 X 是酉矩阵：在非零空间上矛盾。

scenes.name: BEYOND EXACT FAILURE
lines: Exact failure alone would not exclude approximation. The written proof strengthens the contradiction to a Gram error of at least one over one hundred forty four, independent of bath size.
精确失败本身不排除逼近。书面证明进一步给出至少一百四十四分之一的 Gram 误差，与环境大小无关。
Controlling energy leakage then shows that every thermal output misses the target by more than ten to the minus eight in the full trace norm.
再控制能量泄漏，便证明每个热输出与目标的完整迹范数误差都大于十的负八次方。

scenes.name: WHAT IS ESTABLISHED
lines: The public Lean theorem refutes universal exact equivalence. Its proof constructs this example; the quantitative closure bound is a written extension.
公开 Lean 定理否定普遍精确等价，其证明构造了本例；定量闭包界则是书面推广。

Maestro previously separated three levels exactly, while retaining approximation. Four is the closure threshold under distinct-level and distinct-gap assumptions. Arbitrary positive temperature and infinite baths remain outside this result.
Maestro 先前已给出三能级精确分离，但三能级仍可逼近。在能级及正能隙互异的假设下，四是闭包分离阈值；任意正温度与无限环境不在本结论内。
